document.title: feat(sdk): per-package storage API for Deck Apps
document.summary: Adds Deck App Storage: a native per-package JSON store with atomic replace and a 1 MiB cap, two path-free natives, and a `storage` export in `@vitadeck/sdk`. It also replaces the path-taking file natives with `nativeEvalActiveDeckAppEntry()`.
document.why: Deck Apps need data that survives restarts, and no global a Deck App reaches should accept a filesystem path ([#49](source:s1)).

sources.title: Deck App Storage
sources.gist: Approved design: synchronous string `storage` in the SDK, one JSON file per package under deck-app-data, temp-and-rename writes, 1 MiB cap, path-free natives, removal deletes storage, replacement keeps it.

sources.label: PR #84
sources.gist: Implements #49 as approved; lists the agent-check tiers that passed in Docker.

groups.title: Native store and its harness
groups.why: The design puts one JSON file per package under `deck-app-data` and asks for writes that a crash cannot truncate ([#49](source:s1)).
groups.summary: `deck_app_storage.c` reads, writes and removes `<data root>/deck-app-data/<package>/storage.json`, `package_library_remove` calls its removal, and `storage_harness` drives both through crash states and the library.
lookFor: Subtle: every write moves `storage.json` to `storage.json.bak` before renaming the temp file in, even on POSIX, because the Vita's rename does not replace; a crash between the two renames leaves only the backup, and `deck_app_storage_read` returns the previous value from it.

When the package directory is removed but its storage directory is not, `package_library_remove` returns false with "Could not remove Deck App Storage.", so the Shell shows an error for a package that is already gone from the list.

groups.title: Path-free natives and entry loading
groups.why: The design replaces `nativeReadTextFile`, `nativeEvalFile` and `nativeGetActiveDeckAppPath` with natives that take no path ([#49](source:s1)).
groups.summary: `src/jslib/storage.c` wraps the native store as `nativeReadDeckAppStorage`/`nativeWriteDeckAppStorage`, and `nativeEvalActiveDeckAppEntry` in `jslib.c` lets `main.tsx` drop its JS manifest read.
lookFor: `register_js_storage` captures the Active Deck App's package name when the JS thread starts, so a write that lands after a Shell switch but before the restart still goes to the old package.
A setItem past the cap throws `RangeError`; an I/O failure throws `InternalError`, so authors can tell them apart.

The runtime no longer checks `schemaVersion`, `name` or `version` in JS; it relies on `package_manifest_read` in bootstrap, and a package that never registers now fails with "Deck App package did not register a component." without the package name.

groups.title: SDK `storage` and its docs
groups.why: The approved surface is a `storage` export from `@vitadeck/sdk` that keeps the map in memory and writes the whole JSON on every change ([#49](source:s1)).
groups.summary: `storage.ts` loads the map once from `nativeReadDeckAppStorage` and persists a copy on each change, `index.tsx` exports it, minesweeper uses it for a win count, and the README and `CONTEXT.md` describe it.
lookFor: A stored file that is not valid JSON is logged with `console.warn` and loads as empty; the next `setItem` overwrites it, so the unreadable contents are lost.
`setItem` copies the whole `Map` and stringifies the whole store on every call; the in-memory map changes only after the native write returns, so a rejected write leaves `getItem` unchanged.

commits.subject: feat(sdk): storage API for Deck Apps
commits.author: Máté Molnár
commits.body:
storage.getItem/setItem/removeItem keeps the items in memory and writes the whole store through the host on every change. The runtime loads the package entry through nativeEvalActiveDeckAppEntry; the native manifest check already covers what readManifest did. Minesweeper keeps a win count.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commits.subject: feat(core): per-package Deck App Storage with path-free natives
commits.author: Máté Molnár
commits.body:
Adds src/core/deck_app_storage.c (one JSON file per Deck App Package Name under <data root>/deck-app-data, atomic replace, 1 MiB cap) and the nativeReadDeckAppStorage/nativeWriteDeckAppStorage natives. Replaces nativeReadTextFile, nativeEvalFile and nativeGetActiveDeckAppPath with nativeEvalActiveDeckAppEntry, so no global a Deck App reaches takes a path. Installed Deck App Removal deletes the package's storage.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
